roundingAndDefenseStatus.currentObservation: 追加検証により、火種追加ダメージは一括防御補正よりも、式の各パーツに防御補正をかけてそれぞれfloorし、最後に合計する component-wise floor が最有力になった。攻撃側エースバーンLv13/Lv14/Lv15 vs ピカチュウLv15では、パーツ別防御補正が 612/667/726 とすべて一致し、一括防御補正はすべて+1ずれた。ゲッコウガLv15やエースバーン一部Lvでは±1程度のズレが残るため、内部ステータス小数または表示丸め差の可能性を残す。
roundingHypothesisNotes: Most likely formula: floor((Atk * 0.9) * 600 / (Defense + 600)) + floor((EnemyMaxHP * 0.007 * (AttackerLevel - 1)) * 600 / (Defense + 600)) + floor(25 * 600 / (Defense + 600)).
Attacker Lv13/Lv14/Lv15 vs Pikachu Lv15 measured Flare damage 612/667/726 matched component-wise floor exactly; total-before-defense rounding was +1 in all three cases.
Remaining +/-1 cases are compatible with internal non-integer stats or displayed stat rounding, but fully proving that would require very heavy verification.

Project decision: do not overfit the app formula to every +/-1 case yet. Treat component-wise floor as the best measured candidate and plan to show a future note that tiny damage differences may remain for unresolved internal precision.
remainingQuestions: Exact source of remaining +/-1 differences for Greninja Lv15 and some Cinderace levels.
Whether game calculation uses non-integer internal defense/HP values while displayed data is rounded.
Whether all Pokemon beyond the currently verified three follow the same component-wise floor behavior.
Exact interaction with wild Pokemon cap stage remains separate and unresolved.
